imu.part: Bosch BMI088 (built into the Livox Avia)
imu._source: Livox Avia specs list a built-in BMI088 IMU: https://www.livoxtech.com/avia/specs. Numbers from Bosch BST-BMI088-DS000-19 Rev 1.9, see bmi088.json

echo.part: Livox Avia (non-repetitive scan, mounted looking straight down)
echo._source: Livox Avia specs https://www.livoxtech.com/avia/specs: FOV 70.4 x 77.2 deg (non-repetitive), range 190 m @10% / 230 m @20% / 320 m @80% reflectivity at 100 klx, range precision 2 cm (1 sigma @20 m), 240k points/s
echo._max_range_m: ASSUMPTION: the 20% reflectivity range, for granite, scree and forest
echo._noise_frac: ASSUMPTION: precision degrading to ~0.2 m at 200 m
echo._dropout: ASSUMPTION: 2% of points lost (absorbing surfaces, edges)
echo._pattern: ASSUMPTION: each 10 Hz frame is subsampled to a 10 x 10 grid of points over the FOV to keep raycasting cheap; the real sensor gives ~24,000 points per frame
echo._price: roboticscenter.ai Livox Avia, qty 1, 2026-10 (DJI HK store HKD 11,399): https://www.roboticscenter.ai/es/store/product/livox-dji-livox-avia
